title: Reduce Completed pending proof cache export
summary: Removed the transitional Completed pending-proof cache flat export while preserving the mediaPipelineCompletedView namespace helper. Pending Publish, Command History, Sample Validation records, and the Completed/Pending browser smoke now read getLastCompletedPendingProofRows through mediaPipelineCompletedView. WebView inventories and the generated public contract baseline now report 504 flat exports.
reason: Continue low-risk namespace-first WebView cleanup in the touched Completed/Pending proof domain without changing backend routes, mutation authority, pending-publish drain, or media policy.
behavior_before: completedView.js exposed getLastCompletedPendingProofRows both through mediaPipelineCompletedView and as a transitional window.getLastCompletedPendingProofRows flat export. Several frontend consumers and smoke tests still read the flat alias.
behavior_after: getLastCompletedPendingProofRows remains available through mediaPipelineCompletedView only. Touched consumers use the namespace helper, the Completed/Pending browser smoke rejects a served flat assignment, and the documented flat-export count is 504 across 49 files.
tests_added: Extended tests/webview/test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.py to call mediaPipelineCompletedView.getLastCompletedPendingProofRows() and reject a served window.getLastCompletedPendingProofRows flat assignment.
manual_validation: rg -n "window\\.getLastCompletedPendingProofRows\\b" apps tests Docs --glob '!Docs/generated/summaries/**' (exit 1, no matches)
rollback_plan: Restore the window.getLastCompletedPendingProofRows assignment in completedView.js, move the touched consumers back to the flat alias only if compatibility is intentionally required, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and rerun the same WebView/static validation ladder.
notes:
Source-media safety: this is a frontend compatibility-export cleanup only. It does not change backend routes, strict confirmations, repair/apply behavior, pending-publish manifests, drain behavior, filesystem mutation, source/scratch/output handling, FFmpeg arguments, or media policy. No downloads or real-media validation are required for this low-risk WebView namespace cleanup.
